title: Implement authenticated bounded Zephyr SCHC session authority
description: Zephyr has generic SCHC fragmenter/reassembler codecs and an authenticated raw link-payload API, but no production authority binding fragmentation state to the current authenticated peer. Implement the bounded Zephyr owner required by spec/03-adaptation.md section 5.6: install SCHC policy only from authenticated DIO evidence; key every sender/receiver/tombstone/admission floor by full local and remote signing identities, opaque current remote key generation (and local generation if replaceable), and canonical directional Rule ID; carry the authenticated unsigned 24-bit link counter into every transition; revalidate generation before every mutation/control response; invalidate state atomically on revoke/reinstall/rotation; derive 0x78/0x79 from lexicographic full keys and reject equal/mismatched directions; permit ACK/ACK-REQ/abort issuance only from authenticated state transitions; bound peers, active contexts, tombstones, and buffers without hot-path allocation. Expose the metadata/session API needed by Link/L2 without weakening existing replay/authentication.
acceptance_criteria: Focused Zephyr/host tests cover authenticated DIO install/currentness, both canonical directions, mismatched/equal keys, same-key revoke/reinstall generation isolation, stale/fresh 24-bit counters including 0xffffff exhaustion, forged/unauthenticated controls, duplicate/conflicting tiles, allocation exhaustion without eviction, terminal tombstone/hold-down behavior, and atomic output/state on every error. Production Link/L2 consumers can use the API without caller-selected authority.
